pairs.source_text: Which Grove hook action runs on the session_start event?
pairs.source_norm: which grove hook action runs on the session_start event?
pairs.target_text: orient — evaluate the §2 readers at boot: seat, seam reach, packet, envelope, attestation, corpus age, unit manifest, port ownership. Each value produced by an existing reader; nothing hand-maintained. Three-state contract preserved (populated / empty / unreachable).

pairs.source_text: Which Grove hook action runs on the prompt_submit event?
pairs.source_norm: which grove hook action runs on the prompt_submit event?
pairs.target_text: reinject — emit three byte-stable lines from hooks/seat.md. Keeps §2 question 1 alive under compaction; also the only mid-session surface for a lease or attestation that expired since session_start. Nestor-first when installed: put the prompt to nestor_ask ahead of reinject when Nestor is reachable.

pairs.source_text: Which Grove hook action runs on the pre_compact event?
pairs.source_norm: which grove hook action runs on the pre_compact event?
pairs.target_text: reinject — same three byte-stable lines from hooks/seat.md as prompt_submit. Compaction is where the seat rule is most likely to be lost; the reinject on pre_compact is what keeps it from silently going missing across a compress.

pairs.source_text: Which Grove hook action runs on the stop event?
pairs.source_norm: which grove hook action runs on the stop event?
pairs.target_text: gate — refuse a turn claiming done with no evidence token; block once, then advisory (per stop_hook_active). The gate acts per turn; it does not fight the pinentry flow the approval broker §5c is designing.
